title: Verdro's GUI
description: A nice clean remake of Minecraft's GUI
body:
![**< VERDRO'S GUI >**](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/44f5972c348ccfd101f7b021df72f66a8930bd69.png)

<center>
  
A **simple** yet **styled** remake of Minecraft's GUI. Spicing them up while keeping them nice on the eyes

This pack makes the GUI feel new and clean while sticking to simplicity.  
It doesnt throw vanilla out the window and sticks to the original layout for the most part.

This pack redesigns almost every gui asset in minecraft, id say like..  
**60%**..  
maybe?

It shouldnt take too long to finish it though.

I like the way it's turning out.  
I think you will too.


Oh and here's a preview

![Yeah idk how to help you here you gotta see it for yourself :p](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8415ccb3bd164083046a92b3d7eb7789042c2096.png)

-----

_versions other than 1.21.11 may have bugs, so please report them if you find them._

-----
  
Please note, mod support will be less focused on until I finish this main project.

I WANT AT LEAST **2** SUPPORTED MODS BEFORE I RELEASE VUI FOR MODS! So **please** suggest something [here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/11yfDgfhXBGdPZN23swjElnSWHpZUnGnuRGXTFWMLNbA) 

Textures for 0 mods:
[Verdro's GUI for mods](https://modrinth.com/project/verdros-gui-mods/)

</center>
